definition: Issues related to battery drain, poor battery life, device getting too hot, or failing to charge.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of battery, charging, overheating, phone dying quickly.
exclusion_criteria: Does not cover device crashing or freezing unless explicitly linked to battery/power loss.
representative_examples: is an iPhone 7 Plus meant to get so hot when it’s charging?!?!
Tired of charging my phone for mad long for it to die in 30 minutes .. wassup ?
Will iphone SE (ios 11) battery will ever optimise like ios 10 in future
typical_historical_response: Asks to check Battery Health in Settings, points to a KB article on maximizing battery life.
common_confusions: May be confused with 'Software/System Issue' if a user says 'the update ruined my battery'.
why_separate: Battery issues are distinct from general software bugs because they involve specific hardware/power troubleshooting steps rather than resetting the device.

definition: General software bugs, lag, freezing, apps crashing, or errors encountered during iOS/macOS updates.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of phone freezing, crashing, lag, iOS update failures, boot loops.
exclusion_criteria: Excludes specific keyboard bugs (e.g. the 'i' bug) and network connectivity issues.
representative_examples: This IOS 11.0.2 update is trash. Phone has been freezing all day, apps tripping.
My iPhone6 was generally fine until the iOS update crashed it.
Fking brand new MacBook just took a shit after trying to install Sierra
typical_historical_response: Asks for current iOS version, suggests force restart, or asks if it happens in specific apps.
common_confusions: Confused with 'Hardware/Damage Repair' when a user says 'my phone is broken' without specifying if it's a physical or software break.
why_separate: This forms the bulk of traditional software support, handled via standard troubleshooting workflows (restart, update, restore).

definition: Issues specifically regarding typing, keyboard rendering, autocorrect, or predictive text.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of the letter 'i' turning into 'A ?' or a box, autocorrect failing, keyboard lagging.
exclusion_criteria: General lag outside of the keyboard.
representative_examples: fix the little boxes shit we tired of seeing it
what the hell is going on... why is everyone’s phone doing this now I️ I️ I️ I️ when we type the letter 'i'
can y’all fix this i issue please... its been 3 days now. And im tired of my i’s being typed as A’s
approximate_frequency: High (~15-20% due to iOS 11 historical data)
typical_historical_response: Provides a temporary text-replacement workaround via Settings > General > Keyboard, or tells them to update to iOS 11.1.1.
common_confusions: Confused with 'Software/System Issue' since it is technically a software bug.
why_separate: Operationally, typing issues (especially severe ones) have their own immediate workarounds (Text Replacement) that differ completely from standard app crash troubleshooting.

definition: Issues relating to downloading apps, Apple Music, Podcasts, iTunes credit, or iCloud storage.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of App Store, Apple Music, podcast app, iTunes, iCloud storage full, missing songs.
exclusion_criteria: Excludes issues with 3rd-party apps crashing (that belongs in Software/System issue).
representative_examples: I can’t update my apps so some of them I can’t go on anymore
hey @115858 your podcast app is hot garbage since ios 11 came out
How do i pay for something with itunes credit please??
typical_historical_response: Often deflects to a specialized iTunes/Media support team via DM, or provides links to manage Apple ID payments.
common_confusions: Confused with 'Account/Security' when payment methods are declined.
why_separate: Media and purchasing issues fall under a different business unit (Services) than hardware/software troubleshooting.

definition: Physical hardware failures, broken screens, water damage, or unresponsive hardware components (Touch ID, buttons, cameras).
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of cracked screen, water damage, Touch ID broken, camera lens cracked, physical damage.
exclusion_criteria: Excludes battery issues unless physical swelling is mentioned.
representative_examples: Constant screen freezing with a genuine apple screen. How do I get a refund ?
Updates to iOS 11.3 and now my Touch ID isn’t working.
My Cinema Display doesn't work with My macbook touchbar using the correct adaptor.
typical_historical_response: Requires inspecting the device. Points customer to locate an Apple Store or Authorized Service Provider.
common_confusions: Confused with Software bugs when hardware features (like a mic) stop working due to a software glitch.
why_separate: Cannot be fixed via software troubleshooting. Requires physical repair booking.

definition: Issues logging into Apple ID, 2-factor authentication, activation lock, forgotten passwords, or unauthorized charges.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of Apple ID, iCloud login, Activation Error, hacked account, forgotten password.
exclusion_criteria: Excludes simply running out of iCloud storage space (Media Services).
representative_examples: can’t activate my iPhone due to server issues heellllllp
Can yall please call me back so I can sign into my apple account??
I'm getting notified of sign in attempts (by myself) but it keeps saying the wrong location
typical_historical_response: Immediate escalation to DM or secure link due to privacy rules. Points to iforgot.apple.com.
common_confusions: Confused with App Store issues if they can't download an app because of a locked account.
why_separate: High-risk category. The AI agent should almost always escalate these to avoid leaking PII or assisting with social engineering.

definition: Issues connecting to Wi-Fi, cellular data, Bluetooth devices, or AirDrop.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of wifi, bluetooth, no service, dropping calls, airdrop failing.
exclusion_criteria: Excludes issues with specific web services (like Apple Music) if the underlying internet is fine.
representative_examples: I can’t connect to my WiFi even when I’m close to the router. What the heck I need help.
message of i have not data provider, Telcel support review the chip and si not the service
typical_historical_response: Provides KB article on 'Reset Network Settings' or checking carrier updates.
common_confusions: Confused with 'Hardware issue' if the wifi antenna is physically broken.
why_separate: Follows a very standard, distinct troubleshooting tree (Reset Network Settings, contact Carrier).

definition: Questions about how to use a feature, checking compatibility, or general non-broken inquiries.
inclusion_criteria: Questions starting with 'How do I...', 'Is it possible to...', 'Where can I find...'
exclusion_criteria: Excludes questions about fixing something that is actively broken.
representative_examples: how do I add my battery percentage to always show on iPhone X?
is there a page I can check what features of my new beats studio3 wireless aren’t available under iOS 10?
typical_historical_response: Links directly to an Apple Support KB article explaining the feature.
common_confusions: Confused with Software Issues if the user asks 'How do I fix X?'
why_separate: These are low-risk, high-confidence retrieval cases that are perfect for auto-handling via documentation links.

definition: Questions regarding purchasing, shipping status, Apple Store appointments, or returns.
inclusion_criteria: Mentions of order status, delivery, pre-orders, Apple Store appointments, shipping.
representative_examples: My iPhone X order is “In Progress” Ppl who ordered after me are receiving their deliveries already !
Well guys, the solution your team gave me was to buy a replacement from you plus I had to pay the shipping
common_confusions: Confused with App Store queries when the word 'buy' or 'purchase' is used.
why_separate: Requires backend systems (order tracking) that an LLM agent wouldn't have access to; thus, necessitates escalation.

definition: Messages that lack sufficient context to categorize, follow-ups to previous conversations, or rants without an actionable problem.
inclusion_criteria: Extremely short messages, just URLs/Images, 'Yes I did', 'DM?', 'Are you going to help me then?'
exclusion_criteria: Any message with a clear technical problem.
representative_examples: Yes you did thx :)
Just like that!!!
DM?
Are you going to help me then?
typical_historical_response: Asks clarifying questions ('Which OS are you on?'), deflects to DM, or acknowledges the thanks.
common_confusions: Can capture poorly phrased but legitimate issues if the classifier is weak.
why_separate: Crucial for safety. The agent must recognize when it DOES NOT know what the customer is talking about, and escalate rather than guessing.
